visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit indoor venue with a white backdrop labeled 'ON THE MOVE'. A man with black hair, wearing a bright blue suit, black shirt, and a gray patterned tie, stands behind a blue semi-circular table. He gestures enthusiastically with his hands, holding a small black device. Various tech accessories like power banks and cases are neatly arranged on the table. (2) A close-up shot focuses on his hands as he holds a very thin, charcoal-gray MagSafe power bank. He demonstrates its slim profile by placing it next to his finger. The background shows a white wall with minimalist line drawings of people. (3) The man attaches the power bank to the back of a gold-colored iPhone. He then pulls out a small metal kickstand from the bottom of the power bank and rests the phone horizontally on the white tabletop. (4) He presents another gray rectangular power bank with a circular depression in the center, designed for charging an Apple Watch. He points to the charging area while holding it up. (5) The shot changes to show a small, black plastic accessory. The man unfolds it to reveal a short cable with USB-A and USB-C connectors. He is standing in front of a wall with an illustration of an airplane and the word 'TRAVEL'. (6) He compares two travel adapters on the table. One is a large, dark cube, and the other is a significantly smaller, light gray version. He picks up the smaller one and uses his thumb to rotate the plug prongs out from the body. (7) The man holds an orange leather phone case. Attached to the back is a circular, dual-colored magnetic ring (light blue and lime green). He uses his index finger to spin the ring continuously, demonstrating its 360-degree rotation. (8) The final sequence shows a collection of rugged, 'mecha' style AirPods cases in white, orange, and gray. He picks up a white and red case, presses a prominent orange button on the side, and the lid flips open to reveal the interior.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 一次開箱 6個手機周邊. [Subtitle]: 各位現在行動電源越做越薄. (2) [Logo]: ENERGEA. [Subtitle]: MagSafe行動電源. (3) [Subtitle]: 除了可以直接充電之外 重點是 厚度只比USB-C孔再厚一點點 它只做到了9mm. (4) [Subtitle]: 它還放了一個腳架 所以它可以這樣架著有沒有 然後看一下他們未來即將要出的. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個是半固態電池 當然比較安全 然後他們家我很喜歡的點是這樣. (6) [Subtitle]: 凹進去都可以充Apple Watch 然後這個也是最近很流行的 你可以放在包包上. (7) [Subtitle]: 看起來是USB-A孔 但它其實裡面有一個C孔. (8) [Subtitle]: 這裡有 TravelGo. [Subtitle]: 過往大概是這個大小 它把它做到不到1/2的大小. (9) [Subtitle]: 還有一個小巧思 它是這樣子8字自己掰過來 讚 那它有兩個C孔 非常好用. (10) [Logo]: UNIQ. [Subtitle]: 然後UNIQ我非常喜歡的點是 你可以看到它的配色. (11) [Subtitle]: 它都做這種環保的皮革 非常的好搭 而且大家有沒有聽到這個轉的阻尼感 很療癒. (12) [Logo]: SKINARMA. [Subtitle]: 各位我們來看一下Skinarma他們家的AirPods保護殼. (13) [Subtitle]: 它除了原本它自家這種很機甲風的造型之外 還有一點點半透明. (14) [Subtitle]: AirPods會隱隱約約的 有點裸露出來 然後這種按鈕式的打開 有沒有. (15) [Subtitle]: 有點蒸汽龐克 啪 打開來的感覺 真的很帥.
